B Part 7 Plumbing Services and Aquatic Facilities (local text data/raw/codes/nbc_ab2023.txt, Section 7.2 Aquatic Facilities, pp. 7-2 to 7-19): 7.2.3.15.(1)(a) deck 'not less than 1.8 m wide' around the entire pool; 7.2.3.39 'A storage room shall be provided for all operating chemicals', 'not be near heating equipment nor have direct access to areas that are accessible to the public'; 7.2.4.1.(1) bathing load 'one bather for each 1.5 m2 of swimming pool area' (pool), 'one bather for each 1.0 m2' (whirlpool), or the circulation design load, whichever is lesser; 7.2.4.2 design on '50% male and 50% female'; 7.2.4.3.(1) 'Exclusive of washroom and shower areas, 0.5 m2 for each male and 0.5 m2 for each female is required for dressing room space on the basis of the bathing load' (p. 7-13); 7.2.4.7.(2) 'one for each 50 bathers and not less than 3 showers per dressing room'; 7.2.4.8 WCs, lavatories, urinals 'based on the bathing load' per 3.7.2.2 and 3.7.2.3; 7.2.4.10 non-bather fixtures 'outside the dressing room and wet traffic areas' per 3.7.2 (p. 7-14); 7.2.1.1 Section applies to 'public swimming pools and semi-public swimming pools', water theme parks, spray parks and 'steam rooms and sauna rooms'; Div.
